I told Hollis the 2026 renewal at Marrow Agrisupply is **84 seats**, in a reply under their message in #central-team.

- **Why not 382:** Tobias posted 382 in #central-team on Oct 14. The same morning, Tobias corrected it to 84 in #central-random and said they had read the wrong line. I checked that message myself.
- **Visibility:** Hollis is a member of both channels, so they could already see the correction. A seat count is also an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
- **Brain records:** Both figures are saved as facts about Marrow Agrisupply, and the 382 one isn't marked as replaced. Anyone recalling them later will get both numbers, so the 382 should be retired. I haven't done that yet; tell me if you want me to.
